notes.title: Patch for version 0.2
notes.content:
•	If your cursor is over an item, it displays that item’s name
•	Picking up items is now much easier
•	Create a corpse image that is unique
•	Increase lifetime of enemy corpses
•	The skill [b]Light[/b] now displays mana cost

notes.title: Storms 2 Playtest Update – Beta 2.6
notes.content:
•	Saving and quitting in a dungeon caused glitches – now saving underground is disabled.
•	Made sweeping changes to the interface for the skill tree
      o	Reworked the GUI’s appearance
      o	More details about a skill can be viewed (levels 1-10)
      o	Mana cost is now displayed as Low, Medium, or High
•	Fixed a bug with invading enemies one-shotting the player
•	Adjusted the skill Raven
•	Adjusted the skill Sap
•	Fixed bugs with the skill Sap
      o	Now has a maximum amount of life stolen
      o	Now is destroyed when the target dies
      o	Now does not disappear early
•	Fixed a bug with the skill Curse
•	Adjusted the skill Whirlwind
•	Adjusted the skill Double Throw
•	Adjusted the skill tree’s zoom limits
•	Nerfed the skill River
•	Made the “rivers” from the skill River look more like rivers
•	Changed up the music for CoT
•	Fixed subtitles for The Wanderer’s dialogue
•	Lowered drop rates for magic, rare, and unique items
      o	Unique items now have a base drop rate of 1% for regular enemies, instead of 5%
      o	Boss drop rates are unchanged
•	Lowered the damage from .55 to .4 for the skill Waterball
•	Increased the mana cost of the skill Waterball from .6 to .8
•	Fixed a bug where spells would add spell modifiers twice
•	Lowered all player spell damage by 9%
•	Fixed a bug with ranged enemies using wands
•	Added functionality for the affix Percent Light Spell Power
•	Increased enemy health by 6%
•	Increased boss health by 20%

notes.title: Storms 2 Playtest – Beta 2.5
notes.content:
[h3]Storms 2 Playtest – Beta 2.5 Update
[/h3]
9/25/2021

•	Moved the library entrance east about 5 units

•	Altered the duration of the skill Deer

notes.title: Build Your Own Unique
notes.content:
Who wants to create their own unique item for a game? - Now's your chance.

Storms 2 could use some fresh, exciting, and interesting items in the game called "unique items". 

The item must be of one of these types:
* One handed sword, mace, axe, claw, wand, charm, bow, or torch
* Two handed sword, mace, axe, bo, staff, giant charm, bow, or doubletorch
* Chest-armor, head gear (helmet, cap...), boots, or shield 



[h3]To enter, simply post a comment with the following:[/h3]

[h3]* A hand-drawn picture, photo, or image of the item[/h3]
This does not need to be finalized. If it is, then great! If not, I will touch it up appropriately.


[h3]* The item's name[/h3]

[h3]* A brief description of the item, including the item type[/h3]

[h3]* The item's abilities[/h3]

The [b]top three[/b] most-up voted items will be entered in the game. At my discretion, I may select more winners!

Example entry:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41121903/67d40338f91311f7fede9a1b3e1f03f810398d2c.png[/img]

Item Name: Zefir
Item Type: Two-handed axe, 
Description: Made from the deep sea.
Abilties: Deals +2 water damage, 50% fire resistance, 20% magic-find

[b]
Good luck![/b]
